requirements.quote: The changes from `/home/user/patches/new_strings.patch` must be incorporated into the translation files.

check.cmd: [ "$(grep -cE '^\+msg(id|str) ' /home/user/patches/new_strings.patch)" -gt 0 ] && grep -E '^\+msg(id|str) ' /home/user/patches/new_strings.patch | cut -c2- | while IFS= read -r l; do cat /home/user/project/translations/en.po /home/user/project/translations/es.po | grep -qxF -- "$l" || exit 1; done

requirements.quote: The Spanish translation for the new string must be “Adiós”.
The PO-Revision-Date header of BOTH .po files must be updated to the fixed value exactly (including offset):

check.cmd: for f in /home/user/project/translations/en.po /home/user/project/translations/es.po; do grep -qF 'PO-Revision-Date: 2023-10-12 12:00+0000\n' "$f" && [ "$(grep -c 'PO-Revision-Date' "$f")" -eq 1 ] || exit 1; done

requirements.quote: An audit log of your work must be created at `/home/user/project/translation_update.log`
`/home/user/project/translation_update.log` must exist and consist of exactly two lines with the precise format and values described.
The patch adds one new message to both .po files and revises one existing Spanish translation.

check.cmd: grep -qxF '2023-10-12 12:00:00+0000 | en.po | added=1 | updated=0' /home/user/project/translation_update.log && grep -qxF '2023-10-12 12:00:00+0000 | es.po | added=1 | updated=1' /home/user/project/translation_update.log

requirements.quote: Use the timestamp “2023-10-12 12:00:00+0000” (note the seconds field) on both lines.
